research_question: To what extent do official estimates of rent misrepresent the contemporaneous rental spot market, and how do median contract and gross rents compare in Metropolitan Statistical Areas?

phase_1.user_prompt: We are investigating how official survey estimates of rent lag behind or misrepresent the rental spot market. We need to extract the 2014 American Community Survey (ACS) 1-year estimates for both overall median contract rent and overall median gross rent. Which specific ACS tables and variables provide these two median rent figures (contract and gross)?

phase_2.user_prompt: Using the identified variables for Median Contract Rent (B25058_001E) and Median Gross Rent (B25064_001E), please retrieve the 2014 ACS 1-year estimates for all Metropolitan Statistical Areas in the US so we can subsequently filter for our 25 target cities.
